title: •••Echo Base Trooper Officer
caption: •••Echo Base Trooper Officer (V)
game_text: While at a non-shielded marker site, may use 1 Force to suspend ‘Hoth Energy Shield Rules’ until the start of your next turn.
lore: Like many Rebel specialists, Trey Callum defected from the Imperial officer corps. Trooper officers are masters at stretching the meager resources of the Rebellion.
